description: The recommended preset. Each tell is matched against a line after fenced code, inline code, and front matter are stripped. Order matters: tells run top to bottom, and 'pre-entity' tells run before HTML entities are masked. The README's tell table documents each one with an example.

tells.name: em-dash
tells.message: em dash as an HTML entity, write it out plainly

tells.name: section-sign
tells.message: section sign as an HTML entity, write 'section'

tells.name: middle-dot
tells.message: middle dot or bullet as an HTML entity, join the items with a comma or plain words, or separate with ◦

tells.name: curly-quote
tells.message: curly quote as an HTML entity, use a straight quote

tells.name: em-dash
tells.message: em dash in prose, use a colon, comma, parentheses, or two sentences

tells.name: section-sign
tells.message: section sign, write 'section'

tells.name: middle-dot
tells.message: middle dot or bullet in prose, join the items with a comma or plain words, or separate with ◦

tells.name: curly-quote
tells.message: curly quote, use a straight quote

tells.name: bold-bullet-lead
tells.message: bolded bullet lead, reserve bold for a rare callout not a per-item label

tells.name: id-label-lead
tells.message: id label on a list item, number the list plainly

tells.name: semicolon
tells.message: semicolon in prose, prefer a full stop

tells.name: not-just-x-but-y
tells.message: "not just X but Y" padding, make the point once

tells.name: filler-verb
tells.message: filler verb, use a plain verb or cut

tells.name: marketing-adjective
tells.message: marketing adjective, say what is true

tells.name: throat-clearing
tells.pattern: ^\s*(?:[-*+]\s+|>\s*|#{1,6}\s+)?(In today's|It's worth noting that|When it comes to|At its core|Furthermore|Moreover|Additionally|That being said|It's important to (?:note|remember|understand)|It bears mentioning|Importantly|Interestingly|Notably|Ultimately|In the realm of|In an era where|In a world where|Imagine a world where|Picture this|Have you ever wondered|Since the dawn of|As we navigate)\b
tells.message: throat-clearing or transition opener, start with the point

tells.name: vague-intensifier
tells.message: vague intensifier with no number behind it

tells.name: emoji
tells.message: emoji or decorative checkmark in body text

tells.name: chatbot-phrase
tells.pattern: \b(?:I hope this helps|hope th(?:is|at) helps|let me know if|feel free to|would you like me to|if you(?:'d)? (?:want|like), I can|want me to|is there anything else|don't hesitate to|happy to help|shall I)\b|^\s*(?:Of course|Certainly)[.!]
tells.message: chatbot phrase, delete it

tells.name: sycophancy
tells.message: sycophantic tone, respond directly

tells.name: fancy-is
tells.message: fancy way to say 'is', say 'is' or 'has'

tells.name: puffery
tells.message: puffery, state what happened

tells.name: vague-attribution
tells.message: vague attribution, name the source or cut

tells.name: inflated-word
tells.message: inflated word, use a plain one

tells.name: trailing-participle
tells.message: trailing participle clause, say it straight or cut

tells.name: false-exclusivity
tells.pattern: \b(?:what |the (?:part|thing|bit) )?(?:nobody|no one|no-one|few people|most people|everyone)(?: is)? (?:talks? about|talking about|tells? you|mentions?|warns? you(?: about)?|discuss(?:es)?|notices?|reali[sz]es?|gets? (?:this |it )?wrong|miss(?:es)?|overlooks?|forgets?|skips?)\b
tells.message: claim that others miss the point, make the point and cite who missed it

tells.name: hidden-truth
tells.message: promised hidden truth, state the fact plainly

tells.name: real-problem-reframe
tells.pattern: \bthe (?:real|actual|true|bigger|deeper) (?:problem|issue|question|bottleneck|story|work|risk|lesson)(?: here)? (?:isn'?t|is not|wasn'?t|was not)\b|\bthe question (?:isn'?t|is not)\b[^.!?]{1,60}[.,;]\s*it(?:'s| is)\b|\b[\w-]+ (?:isn'?t|is not|wasn'?t) the (?:real |actual )?(?:problem|bottleneck|issue|point)[.,:]|\b(?:it|this) (?:was|is) never (?:really )?about\b
tells.message: reframe to a "real" problem, name the problem and show why

tells.name: false-suspense
tells.pattern: \bhere'?s (?:the (?:thing|kicker|catch|deal|twist|truth|reality|secret|rub|part)|where (?:it|things) gets? (?:interesting|tricky|weird|good)|what (?:most|nobody|no one|everyone|few|I (?:learned|found|mean|noticed)|you need to know|matters)|why (?:this|that|it) matters)\b|\bthe kicker\b
tells.message: false suspense before a reveal, start with the point

tells.name: rhetorical-self-answer
tells.message: question answered at once, state the answer as a sentence

tells.name: emphasis-crutch
tells.pattern: \blet that sink in\b|\bread that again\b|\bfull stop\.|\bmake no mistake\b|\bI'?ll say it again\b|\bthink about that for a (?:second|moment)\b|\byes, really\b
tells.message: emphasis crutch, cut it and let the point stand

tells.name: staged-candor
tells.pattern: (?:^|[.!?]\s+)(?:and |but )?(?:honestly|frankly|look|real talk|truthfully)\?|\b(?:let'?s be honest|to be (?:honest|frank)|if I'?m (?:being )?honest|I'?ll be honest|in all honesty|(?:(?:the|my|an) )?honest (?:take|assessment)|(?:the|my) honest (?:answer|truth))\b
tells.message: staged candor, drop the honesty marker and make the claim

tells.name: mic-drop
tells.pattern: \b(?:that'?s|this is|which is) (?:exactly )?the (?:whole |entire |real )?point\b|\b(?:that'?s|this is) the (?:beauty|power|magic) of\b|\b(?:this|that) is what [^.!?]{1,40} (?:actually |really )?looks like\b|\band that'?s (?:okay|fine|the point|the whole point)\.|^\s*(?:it|this|that) (?:matters|works|scales|compounds|shows)\.\s*$
tells.message: mic-drop line that grades the point, cut it or add a fact

tells.name: negation-pivot
tells.pattern: \b(?:it|this|that|they|these)(?:'s|'re| is| are| was| were)? ?(?:not|n't)\b[^.!?]{1,60}[.,;:]\s*(?:it|this|that|they)(?:'s|'re| is| are| was) (?:a|an|the|about|just|simply|really|actually|more|less|what|how|why)\b|\bnot because\b[^.!?]{1,80}[.,]\s+because\b|\byou don'?t need (?:more |another |a |an )?[^.!?]{1,40}[.,]\s+you need\b
tells.message: "it's not X, it's Y" pivot, say what it is

tells.name: importance-flag
tells.pattern: \b(?:this|that|which|it) (?:\w+ )?matters because\b|\bwhy (?:this|that|it) matters\b|\b(?:this|that|the) (?:distinction|difference|nuance|detail|choice|framing) matters\b|\bmatters more than (?:ever|you think)\b
tells.message: says it matters instead of showing why, give the consequence

tells.name: signposting
tells.message: essay signpost, cut the announcement and keep the point

tells.name: urgency-inflation
tells.message: inflated stakes, give the reason it is urgent

tells.name: stacked-hedge
tells.message: stacked hedge, keep one hedge or none

tells.name: tradeoff-dodge
tells.message: claims the gain costs nothing, state the tradeoff or show there is none
